summary: Each acceptance criterion may carry a proof level, set at DEFINE: full (the structural check and the mutation proof over its Code Node symbols, today's behaviour), journey (the structural check over its e2e-level bound tests only, no mutants, no Code Node) or external (no structural check, no mutants, no Code Node; result notApplicable, proved by the release Verify). The field is optional with no schema default, and absent means full everywhere, so a chain that sets no level produces the 0.40.1 output byte for byte. rcf audit test-strength, rcf build verdict test and rcf build finalise read it; the writer carries it; define validate, verify run --release, audit coverage and audit separation are unchanged. Round G, rcf-lite 0.41.0 over rcf-schemas 0.11.0; criteria AC-19905-1 to AC-19905-15 (US-19905), AC-19905-13 to -15 the successors of AC-19502-3 to -5 (FBS-232).
approach: The design, in the stage-keeper's rulings 5 to 11 of the round G DEFINE. Ruling 5, schema: acceptanceCriterion.proof, enum full | journey | external, optional, no schema default (the verification precedent, ADR-4152); a valid fixture per value and one invalid fixture (rcf-schemas, written at DEFINE). Ruling 6: absent means full, everywhere; a chain with no proof produces the 0.40.1 output byte for byte (the golden test/cli/fixtures/test-strength-proof-absent-0-40-1.json, AC-19905-1). Ruling 7: explicit only; a criterion with verification external and no proof stays full; nothing infers a level (AC-19905-2). Ruling 8: blueprint template criteria keep the default (full); per-criterion proof in blueprints is out of scope. Ruling 9, per verb, per level: define validate unchanged; audit test-strength journey is the structural check over e2e-level bound tests only (a bound test counts as e2e-level when the test suite holding its test case has testLevel e2e), no mutants, no Code Node reason, result pass with proof journey, and a journey criterion with no e2e-level bound test fails with the reason "journey: no e2e-level bound test"; external is result notApplicable with reason "external: proved by the release Verify", counted in the summary; build verdict test exempts external-level bound tests from the TAP presence check; build finalise accepts pass (journey) and notApplicable (external) without a Code Node; verify run --release, audit coverage and audit separation unchanged. Ruling 10, writer: proof is carried by rcf define --from-file and preserved under --set, and settable with --set proof=<level>. Ruling 11: a mix still fails; one full criterion failing plus external ones exits 4 and the record is fail. The report (TestStrengthReport stays v1, optional fields added only when the chain sets a level): a criterion whose chain record carries proof (any value) reports it as proof directly after acId; a criterion with no proof reports no proof field; an external criterion reports exactly { acId, proof, structural: { checked: false }, mutants: [], result: notApplicable, reason } in that order; totals gains criteriaNotApplicable (the count of external criteria) only when it is above 0, and totals.notApplicable keeps counting mutants; the PASS line keeps its form with structural <passed>/<full and journey criteria> and the mutant counts over the full criteria, and only when at least one criterion is external gains the suffix "; external <n>: <ids in id order, comma-separated> (external: proved by the release Verify)"; the FAIL and BLOCKED lines keep their form, counting every criterion in scope. The schema route (rulings 4 and 16): the rcf-schemas builder's commit sets version 0.11.0-rc.0 and the owner pushes the tag v0.11.0-rc.0 (npm dist-tag prerelease, never latest); the rcf-lite builder pins exactly 0.11.0-rc.0 at packages/rcf-lite/package.json:75 with the lockfile and a minimumReleaseAgeExclude entry in pnpm-workspace.yaml beside the existing '@stravica-ai/rcf-schemas@0.5.1 || 0.7.0' line for Build; at the Build-to-Review seam, once the suite is green against the rc, the owner publishes rcf-schemas 0.11.0 from the same schema source and the builder's last BUILD: commit moves the pin to exactly 0.11.0 with the lockfile and the minimumReleaseAgeExclude line, and the suite re-runs; Review and Test see the final pin. Ruling 17: AC-19502-3 to -5 are retired and succeeded by AC-19905-13 to -15 (the Given the pin at rcf-schemas 0.11.0).
